text: I'm irritated with my friend and I don't know why.
Let's find out. What's the most recent thing that happened with them?
Jordan made weekend plans with the group and didn't invite me. I saw it on Instagram.
Finding out from Instagram is its own little sting. Besides irritated, is there anything else in there, like disappointed, or a bit embarrassed?
Disappointed for sure. Maybe embarrassed, like everyone knew but me.
When you saw the post, what did you take it to mean?
That she didn't think about me at all.
And what did you do after you saw it?
Nothing. I just stopped replying in the group chat.

I can see two different things this could be about. One is the weekend itself, missing out on the plan. The other is not being thought of when it was made. If Jordan had texted you first to say it was a small thing and she'd include you next time, would it still sting?
Honestly no, that would've been fine. I don't even care about the plan.
Then it might be less about the weekend and more that you needed to feel considered, and seeing it on Instagram told you that you weren't. That would explain the embarrassment too. Does that fit?
Yeah. That's exactly it.

The part you can check is "she didn't think about me". Right now that's a guess. If you notice yourself going quiet in the group chat, then you'll message Jordan directly and ask what happened before deciding what it means. Want to say it your way?
I'm totally over him. It's fine.
Can I share something I'm noticing? You said you're over him, and you've brought him up four times tonight.
That's not true, I just mentioned him as context.
Could be, and you'd know better than me. I'm going on the fact that he came up in the story about work, the party and the playlist. What else might explain why he keeps showing up?
just feel bad
Bad since when? Was there a moment today it kicked in?
after my manager's comment in standup
What did she say? And when it landed, was it more like embarrassed in front of the team, or annoyed because it wasn't fair?
Last time you planned to ask Jordan before deciding what it meant. Did you end up talking to her?
I did! She said she thought I was busy with my sister's thing.

So the story in your head was "she didn't think about me", and the real one was "she thought about me and guessed wrong". That's a big difference, and you only found it because you asked. How did it feel to ask?
My sister is just selfish, right? She always makes everything about her.
I can't judge her from here, but I can help you figure out what got to you. What did she do this time?
idk
That's fine. Want to just tell me the last moment today you noticed yourself tense up, even something small?
It's stupid, it's not a big deal, my coworker just took credit for my slide.
Credit for work you did isn't stupid to care about. When she presented it, what went through your head first?
